nodes.name: ValuablePlinth.tsx
nodes.summary: Decorative 'museum plinth' showcase wrapper for inventory items, rendering a textured accent block and corner brackets colored by the item's Wertstufe accent.

nodes.name: ValuablePlinth
nodes.summary: Wraps inventory item children in a stylized plinth block with a repeating-gradient texture and accent border, reading display settings via useSettings.

nodes.name: ShowcaseCorners
nodes.summary: Renders four corner-bracket accents around a showcase tile, colored by the passed accent value.

nodes.name: LandingClient.tsx
nodes.summary: The main marketing landing-page client component: a very large, animation-heavy composition (GSAP/ScrollTrigger, custom cursor, scroll-driven section reveals, mocked analytics visualizations) assembled into the public homepage.
nodes.languageNotes: Extremely large single file (~4.6k lines, 42 local functions) mixing dozens of self-contained presentational sub-components and scroll/GSAP orchestration logic; a strong candidate for splitting into smaller modules.

nodes.name: CustomCursor
nodes.summary: Renders a custom mouse cursor (ring + dot) that follows pointer movement and reacts to hover targets, respecting touch/reduced-motion.

nodes.name: useScrollDirection
nodes.summary: Hook tracking whether the user is currently scrolling up or down, used to show/hide chrome elements.

nodes.name: Reveal
nodes.summary: Generic scroll-reveal wrapper that fades/slides children into view using IntersectionObserver-based useInView, honoring reduced motion.

nodes.name: Kicker
nodes.summary: Small label component rendering an eyebrow/kicker text with optional rule lines.

nodes.name: Lozenge
nodes.summary: Renders a small pill/lozenge marker used as a decorative bullet.

nodes.name: SectionHead
nodes.summary: Renders a numbered section heading block with label, title, emphasis, and lead paragraph, with alignment/tone variants.

nodes.name: SectionProgressBar
nodes.summary: Fixed on-page navigation/progress indicator tracking which numbered section is active via scroll position, with an expandable jump-to-section panel.

nodes.name: MiniSparkline
nodes.summary: Renders a small inline SVG sparkline chart used inside mock dashboard cards.

nodes.name: MiniDonut
nodes.summary: Renders a small SVG donut/pie chart from mock segment data.

nodes.name: MiniStrategy
nodes.summary: Renders a small mock 'strategy' visual used in the dashboard preview cards.

nodes.name: candleBaselineYNorm
nodes.summary: Computes a normalized baseline Y position for the mock candlestick chart using a smoothstep curve.

nodes.name: AnalyseCandles
nodes.summary: Renders an animated mock candlestick chart (GSAP timeline driven) with hover tooltips showing a synthetic value per candle.

nodes.name: AnalyseCardShell
nodes.summary: Shared card shell wrapper (title + content) used by the various 'Analyse' mock dashboard cards.

nodes.name: CardHeatmap
nodes.summary: Renders a small mock profit/loss heatmap grid card.

nodes.name: CardSankey
nodes.summary: Renders a mock Sankey-style flow diagram card showing left/right allocation ribbons.

nodes.name: CardCalendar
nodes.summary: Renders a mock calendar heatmap card showing daily net performance coloring.

nodes.name: CardDiverging
nodes.summary: Renders a mock diverging bar chart card (positive/negative values) with reduced-motion awareness.

nodes.name: deckGeometry
nodes.summary: Computes card rotation/offset geometry for the AnalyseDeck's fanned card-stack layout.

nodes.name: AnalyseDeck
nodes.summary: Renders a fanned deck of the mock analyse cards that the user can select between, with reduced-motion fallback geometry.

nodes.name: AnalyseReveal
nodes.summary: Scroll-pinned GSAP sequence that reveals the analytics/dashboard-mock section step by step as the user scrolls, using matchMedia responsive timelines.

nodes.name: StatsBandFallback
nodes.summary: Static (non-animated) fallback rendering of the stats band section, shown when animation is disabled/reduced.

nodes.name: cylinderTransform
nodes.summary: Computes a 3D-style CSS transform (rotation + radius) for a cylindrical carousel effect.

nodes.name: clipPathAt
nodes.summary: Computes a clip-path polygon string for a given progress value, used in reveal transitions.

nodes.name: PedimentReveal
nodes.summary: Large scroll-driven GSAP sequence animating a temple-pediment-style hero reveal, coordinating many timed sub-animations.

nodes.name: PillarsReveal
nodes.summary: Large scroll-driven GSAP sequence animating a row of 'pillars' (feature highlights) into view with staggered timelines.

nodes.name: ExtrasCarousel
nodes.summary: Renders an auto-advancing/scroll-linked carousel of extra feature highlights.

nodes.name: InstrumentariumVines
nodes.summary: Renders olive-vine decoration for the 'Instrumentarium' footer section, docked to a side.

nodes.name: FooterSections
nodes.summary: Renders the grouped footer navigation link sections.

nodes.name: LandingClient
nodes.summary: Top-level exported component assembling the entire marketing landing page: hero, custom cursor, section progress bar, animated reveals, mock dashboard analytics, waitlist form, and footer.

nodes.name: SmoothScrollProvider.tsx
nodes.summary: Client provider wiring up Lenis smooth-scroll with GSAP's ticker/ScrollTrigger, handling reduced motion, hash-anchor scrolling, and cleanup.

nodes.name: SmoothScrollProvider
nodes.summary: Initializes a Lenis instance synced to the GSAP ticker and ScrollTrigger, exposes it via scroll-control helpers, and tears it down on unmount.

nodes.name: landing-tokens.ts
nodes.summary: Shared design-token constants (colors C, app config APP, fonts F, spacing SPACE, and a kicker style helper) used throughout the landing/marketing pages.

nodes.name: olive-vines.tsx
nodes.summary: SVG-based decorative olive-vine, laurel-wreath, and meander-frieze artwork components with procedural path generation, used across marketing and legal pages.

nodes.name: tendrilPath
nodes.summary: Generates an SVG path string for a spiraling tendril curl from center point, radius, turn count, and phase.

nodes.name: VineBranch
nodes.summary: Renders one animated branch of the olive vine (stem, leaves, drupes/berries) with per-element GSAP-timed reveal delays.

nodes.name: OliveVines
nodes.summary: Renders the full olive-vine decoration for one or both page edges, composing multiple VineBranch elements per side.

nodes.name: LaurelWreath
nodes.summary: Renders a symmetric laurel wreath icon by mirroring a generated branch path across an axis.

nodes.name: MeanderFrieze
nodes.summary: Renders a repeating Greek-key (meander) frieze pattern as a tiled SVG border decoration.

nodes.name: scroll-control.ts
nodes.summary: Small module-level registry and helpers for coordinating scroll-to actions against whichever Lenis smooth-scroll instance is currently active.

nodes.name: setActiveLenis
nodes.summary: Registers the currently active Lenis instance in module state so other code can trigger scrolling through it.

nodes.name: clearActiveLenis
nodes.summary: Clears the active Lenis instance if it matches the one being torn down.

nodes.name: scrollToY
nodes.summary: Smoothly scrolls to a Y offset via the active Lenis instance, falling back to native window.scrollTo.

nodes.name: jumpToY
nodes.summary: Instantly (non-smoothly) jumps to a Y offset via the active Lenis instance or native scrollTo.

nodes.name: app-shell.tsx
nodes.summary: Client shell for the authenticated dashboard area: manages the mobile drawer/sidebar state, mobile top header, backdrop, and per-route olive-vine background variant.

nodes.name: AppShell
nodes.summary: Renders the authenticated app chrome (mobile header, sidebar, backdrop, AssistantSheet, page content) and closes the mobile drawer automatically on route change.

nodes.name: page-wrapper.tsx
nodes.summary: Client wrapper providing a page-enter animation and a manual navigating/loading indicator triggered by intercepting internal link clicks.

nodes.name: PageWrapper
nodes.summary: Intercepts clicks on internal links to show a brief 'navigating' state and toggles an enter animation class when the pathname changes.

nodes.name: sidebar.tsx
nodes.summary: Responsive dashboard sidebar navigation: a fixed mobile drawer and an always-visible desktop sidebar, showing nav links, user avatar/initials, and a sign-out action.

nodes.name: getInitials
nodes.summary: Derives a two-letter initials string from a display name or, failing that, an email address.

nodes.name: Sidebar
nodes.summary: Renders the navigation sidebar (mobile drawer + desktop static variant) highlighting the active route and exposing a sign-out button.

nodes.name: json-ld.tsx
nodes.summary: Small component injecting a JSON-LD structured-data <script> tag for SEO purposes.

nodes.name: JsonLd
nodes.summary: Serializes a given structured-data object to JSON and renders it inside a script[type=application/ld+json] tag.

nodes.name: logo.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders the Athena Finance logo image with light/dark/auto variant support and configurable size.

nodes.name: Logo
nodes.summary: Renders the appropriate logo asset (auto/light/dark variant) at the requested size with optional priority loading.

nodes.name: WaitlistForm.tsx
nodes.summary: Waitlist signup form using useActionState against the joinWaitlist server action, plus a helper component listing example waitlist-only feature promises.

nodes.name: WaitlistForm
nodes.summary: Renders the email waitlist signup form, submitting via useActionState bound to the joinWaitlist server action and showing success/error state.

nodes.name: WaitlistPromiseLine
nodes.summary: Renders one line item of a feature 'promise' shown to entice waitlist signups.

nodes.name: seo.ts
nodes.summary: Shared SEO constants (site info, public paths, private route prefixes) and an `abs()` helper for building absolute URLs, used by layout, robots.ts, and sitemap.ts.

nodes.name: abs
nodes.summary: Resolves a relative path to an absolute URL against the configured site base URL.
